common.failed: That did not work. Try again in a moment.

theme.label: Appearance
theme.help: "System" follows your computer or phone. Saved in this browser only.

guard.missing_device: That device was not found. Pick it again from the device list.
guard.missing_app: That app was not found. Pick it again from the app list.
guard.sign_in_first: Sign in first, then pick from the list.
guard.not_found: That address does not exist, so you are on the status page.

reason.device_offline: This device is not connected right now.
reason.need_usbip_ds5: Choose DualSense (usbip_ds5) as the virtual gamepad for ARBS to work.
reason.no_crash: There is no crash record to download.
reason.password_mismatch: The new password and the confirmation do not match.
reason.service_locked: The start mode cannot be changed on this PC (no service or no permission).

auth.login_help: Enter the ARBS-H administrator name and password.
auth.create_help: You only do this once. This name and password sign you in to every interface.
auth.remember: Stay signed in on this device
auth.wrong: The username or password is wrong.

offline.title: Cannot reach ARBS-H
offline.help: This closes by itself when ARBS-H answers again.

save.label: Save settings
save.hint: Changes apply only after you press "Save".

footer.third_party: This interface uses Vue, Vue Router, Vue I18n and Pinia (MIT licence). Origin and third-party notices are linked below.

status.lead: See at a glance whether ARBS-H is ready to stream.
status.warn_app_running: An app is still running (no device connected).
status.warn_encoder: The encoder check failed. Check the graphics driver.
status.update_failed: Could not check for updates (check the internet connection).
status.update_help: Download the installer from the release page and run it. Your settings are kept.
status.no_sessions: No device is streaming right now.

devices.lead: See the devices paired through Moonlight and others, and change their names and permissions.
devices.empty: No device is paired yet. Press "Pair a device".
devices.name: Device name
devices.allow_sleep: Allow this device to put the PC to sleep
devices.unpair_confirm: Unpair {name}? You will have to pair it again to use it.
devices.save_failed: Could not save the device settings.
devices.load_failed: Could not load the device list.

pair.title: Pair a device
pair.lead: Enter the PIN shown on the client (Moonlight and others) and approve it.
pair.step1: Pick this PC on the client. It shows a PIN.
pair.step2: Enter a device name and the PIN below, then press "Approve".
pair.name: Device name
pair.pin_help: Up to 4 digits. Leading zeros are added for you.

controller.lead: Let controllers such as the APEX feel the host game's rumble, triggers and HD haptics.
controller.input_help: When off, controller input from the client is ignored.
controller.gamepad_warning: ARBS passes trigger effects and HD haptics only with DualSense (usbip_ds5). With this type you get plain rumble only.
controller.rumble_help: Sends the game's rumble to the client controller.
controller.trigger_help: How adaptive trigger effects are reported to the game. Usually keep h2b.
controller.trigger_restart: After saving, restart ARBS-H or reconnect the controller to apply it.
controller.gain_help: 0.0 to 4.0, default 1.0. Too high can sound distorted.
controller.per_app: The per-app HD haptics switch is on the Apps page.
controller.precise_help: Measures network time more precisely. On by default.
controller.precise_restart: After saving, restart ARBS-H to apply it.

display.lead: Choose the display and resolution used for streaming, and recover display problems.
display.windows_only: This card is used on Windows only.
display.mode_help: A virtual display is not limited by the physical monitor's resolution.
display.resolution_manual: Fixed resolution (set the value in all settings)
display.resolution_help: Whether the display resolution changes when a stream starts.
display.reset_help: Forgets the saved display layout. Use it when the layout is wrong.
display.snapshot_old: It differs from the current layout
display.terminate_help: Ends a virtual display that is left over after streaming.

apps.lead: Add and edit the apps the client can launch.
apps.system_help: Recreates a built-in app you deleted.
apps.name: Name
apps.cmd_help: Program path or command to run. Leave empty to show only the desktop.
apps.haptics_help: Turns on PCM HD haptics for this app (when the virtual gamepad is usbip_ds5).
apps.load_failed: Could not load the app list.

trouble.lead: End a stuck app, restart ARBS-H, or read the logs.
trouble.force_close_help: Ends the running app and the stream.
trouble.restart_help: Reads the settings again and starts over. Streaming stops.
trouble.start_with_windows_help: ARBS-H starts by itself when the PC turns on.
trouble.restart_also: "Restart ARBS-H" is in Quick actions above.
trouble.crash_help: Download the record of an unexpected exit.

account.lead: Sign out, change the password, and choose the appearance and the first page.
account.default_ui_help: The page that opens at the address /. Press "Save" after choosing.
account.default_ui_note: You can always open the classic interface at /?ui=classic.
